scope: Visual review of nine ordered stills per scene and profile. Acceptance applies to the visible motion criteria in these samples.

findings.movement: Both profiles show the player banking along and offshore in the coast scene, and crossing the bow of a moving carrier as escorts and the camera track through the fleet scene. The blue ring follows the player and the directional indicators update.
findings.wakes: Fleet wakes stay on the stern side as ships travel and pass out of view. The pale tapers remain a little soft and vapor-like.
findings.coastline: Rock rows, runway and shallows scroll coherently in both profiles. The shoreline remains visible through all samples. Thin foam strokes are segmented and the narrow beach edge still has simple geometry.
findings.impacts: At 006 and 012, the player flashes white, the hull indicator falls from 35% to 27%, and a compact orange impact is visible. Bright paired tracers remain readable; the burst at 060 disperses into darker smoke and dim sparks in later samples.
findings.temporalConsistency: No obvious sampled geometry loss or effect discontinuity. Fallback is visibly softer and can merge a passing aircraft with deck markings. At coast 180 the Hawk label touches the top objective area in both profiles.

limits: The intervals between stills leave unsampled transitions. These images cannot measure continuous animation smoothness, frame pacing, hardware performance, or comparative motion against another candidate.
